description:
Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
A Diwali Filled with Smiles – Spreading Happiness and Hope

Venue: BMC School for Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing Students, Shivdi, Wadala Estate (Opp. Andhra School)

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown facilitated a special Diwali distribution programme for students with hearing and speech disabilities.

With the support of generous sponsors and well-wishers, the students received hearing aids, Ration kits and other essential items to make their Diwali brighter.

The initiative brought festive cheer, dignity and a sense of belonging to the students and their families.

This Diwali, we did not just distribute gifts; we shared happiness, spread hope and created memories that will last a lifetime.

Because every smile is a celebration, and every act of kindness lights a diya in someone's life.

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown
